title: Determination 2024/032: Compliance with Building Code Clause D1 of a pedestrian walkway located in a retirement village
jurisdiction: New Zealand: Wellington City Council as territorial authority; MBIE determination under the Building Act 2004. Non-Alberta comparative record.
code_edition: NZ Building Code (Schedule 1, Building Regulations 1992), clause D1 and section 118. No Acceptable Solution edition is named in the text read.

facts.text: The property is a retirement village in a residential suburb of Wellington. It has been developed in stages since 2003.
Pedestrian access between the upper and lower levels is by two ramps to the south and by the walkway in question.
The walkway is constructed at approximately 1:6 grade (9.46 degrees), between a vehicle accessway and a concrete retaining wall forming a courtyard. The lower level has communal facilities.
The applicant's concern is about access for disabled people between the two levels of the property.
The matter to be determined under section 177(1)(a) is the compliance of the walkway with clause D1. Sections 117-118, and the objective in clause D1.1(c), are considered.

limitations: Only the facts and decision were read in this pass. The section 118 reasoning in §4-5 should be checked before any use.
The record concerns one retirement-village walkway. It is not a general ruling on ramps.
